sum: REalloys Inc. operates as a rare earth metals and materials company in North America. The company produces rare earth metals, including neodymium, praseodymium, dysprosium, terbium, samarium, gadolinium, yttrium, and scandium, as well as magnets, such as NdFeB, SmFe12, and MnBi magnets. The company was founded in 2024 and is based in Boca Raton, Florida.
